rules.name: rrr-new-deals-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT t.trade_id, t.contract_number, t.counterparty_parent, t.subportfolio, t.deal_status, t.transaction_date, t.original_lots, t.created_by, t.created_timestamp, t.updated_by, t.updated_timestamp, t.security_id, (b.trade_id IS NOT NULL) AS in_migration_copy FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table b ON b.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = t.business_unit AND b.trade_id = t.trade_id AND b.is_latest_version = 1 WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('MAN', 'DCS') AND (b.trade_id IS NULL OR upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) = 'DCS') ORDER BY t.contract_number LIMIT 200

SELECT t.created_by, CAST(t.created_timestamp AS date) AS created_day, COUNT(*) AS n_deals, MIN(t.transaction_date) AS first_transaction_date, MAX(t.transaction_date) AS last_transaction_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.transaction_date < :valueDate AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table b WHERE b.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = t.business_unit AND b.trade_id = t.trade_id AND b.is_latest_version = 1) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n_deals DESC LIMIT 50
